title: Auditing Safety Preference Supervision with Recorded Derivations
abstract: arXiv:2610.27266v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference labels align model training, but the judgments behind them are difficult to inspect or verify. In this paper, we examine how preference construction can be checked when intermediate decisions are recorded, and which of them remain uncertain. We present Symbolic Preference Labeling, a method in which a pretrained language model classifies predefined attributes of prompts and responses. Explicit rules assign response verdicts, and a fixed verdict ranking determines the preference label. Each preference label has a recorded derivation: the response verdicts and preference label can be recomputed from the stored attribute assignments, rules, and verdict ranking without rerunning the language model. On 200 prompts annotated by human raters, the language model produces valid structured outputs for 192 prompts. All eight parsing failures occur in the subset of self-harm prompts marked as harmful. translated_title: 基于记录推导的安全偏好监督审计
translated_abstract: 偏好标签用于对齐模型训练，但其背后的判断难以检查或验证。在本文中，我们研究了当中间决策被记录时如何对偏好构建过程进行检查，以及其中哪些部分仍然存在不确定性。我们提出了符号化偏好标注，这是一种由预训练语言模型对提示词和响应的预定义属性进行分类的方法。明确的规则为响应分配判定结果，固定的判定排序决定偏好标签。每个偏好标签都具有可记录的推导过程：响应判定和偏好标签可以从存储的属性分配、规则和判定排序中重新计算得出，而无需重新运行语言模型。在由人工标注者标注的200个提示词上，语言模型为192个提示词生成了有效的结构化输出。全部八次解析失败都发生在被标记为有害的自残提示词子集中。使用465个偏好对，我们训练……
tldr: 该论文提出符号化偏好标注方法，通过记录属性分类、明确规则和固定判定排序，使每个安全偏好标签都能从存储的推导过程中重新计算验证，从而实现对偏好监督的可审计性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Symbolic Preference Labeling, an auditable method in which each safety preference label can be recomputed and verified from recorded attribute assignments, explicit rules, and a fixed verdict ranking without rerunning the language model.
